description: Stock kept for repairs: scraps of old paper matched to a book in tone and texture, and very thin near-transparent Japanese paper used to bridge tears across printed areas. Where no matching tone exists, similar paper is stained to suit.
name: mending paper

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter IV, p.67. Internet Archive.
